title: Aina za nomino (Theme 1: Usafi wa kibinafsi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child decides whether a word names one particular person, place or thing (pekee, capital) or a kind (kawaida, small letter), including titles joined to names.

floor.question: Ni nomino ya pekee ipi: mto, Nzoia?

steps: Is a title joined to a name?
contexts: personal hygiene (usafi wa kibinafsi): a visit to Dkt. Wambui

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes two sentences: one with the title alone, one with title + name.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya pekee?" Kwa nini "mji" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ya pekee ni jina mahususi la mtu au mahali, kama Kisumu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nomino ya pekee huandikwa kwa herufi gani mwanzoni?" Kwa nini "Herufi ndogo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ya pekee huanza kwa herufi kubwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya kawaida?" Kwa nini "Wanjiru" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ya kawaida ni jina la jumla, kama kijiji.

misconceptions.ask: Cheo hiki kimeambatana na jina la mtu?
misconceptions.repair: Cheo kinapotangulia jina huanza kwa herufi kubwa: Daktari Otieno.

checks.question: Andika vizuri: tulikutana na mwalimu mkuu bi. akinyi.
checks.answer: Tulikutana na Mwalimu Mkuu Bi. Akinyi.

checks.question: Ni nomino ya kawaida ipi: Mombasa, bandari, Jumamosi?
